rules.statement: The right to re-transfer property under a pactum de retrovendendo can be enforced by the heirs of the original owner, even if not expressly provided for in the agreement.
rules.supporting_quote: "Moreover not only does the seller sue on this agreement, but also his heir, according to the usual nature of agreements, the benefit of which enures to heirs just as much as to the actual parties to the agreements. So much is this so that if certain of the heirs do not wish to buy back, that right accrues to the remaining heirs."
